traits: Cap up to 8 cm, convex, sulphur-yellow, sometimes brownish at the centre, faint boss
Thin flesh; strong smell of coal gas (skatole), nauseating; bitter taste
Deciduous woods, especially beech · spring to autumn
safetyNote: Toxic: the DGfM lists it for a gastrointestinal syndrome, and Wikipedia (en) calls it inedible and suspected poisonous, with some neurological symptoms reported. Smell and colour tell it from the yellow knight, which is darker, with a sticky cap, white flesh, thin crowded gills and a smell of flour (Wikipedia, en).

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Liste der Giftpilze mit Syndromen, sortiert nach Taxa, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
